arxiv-2004-12298.title: Triangulated categories of logarithmic motives over a field
arxiv-2004-12298.creator: Federico Binda, Doosung Park, Paul Arne Østvær
arxiv-2004-12298.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Federico Binda, Doosung Park, Paul Arne Østvær. In this work, we develop a theory of motives for logarithmic schemes over fields in the sense of Fontaine, Illusie, and Kato. Our construction is based on the notion of finite log correspondences, the dividing Nisnevich topology on log schemes, and the basic idea of parameterizing homotopies by □ ¯ \overline{\Box} ; the projective line with respect to its compactifying logarithmic structure at infinity.

arxiv-2308-07404.title: Benford Behavior of a Higher-Dimensional Fragmentation Process
arxiv-2308-07404.creator: Irfan Durmić, Steven J. Miller
arxiv-2308-07404.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Irfan Durmić, Steven J. Miller. Nature and our world have a bias! Roughly 30 % 30\% of the time the number 1 1 occurs as the leading digit in many datasets base 10 10 . This phenomenon is known as Benford’s law and it arrises in diverse fields such as the stock market, optimizing computers, street addresses, Fibonacci numbers, and is often used to detect possible fraud.

arxiv-2309-13505.title: Rewrite Caption Semantics: Bridging Semantic Gaps for Language-Supervised Semantic Segmentation
arxiv-2309-13505.creator: Yun Xing, Jian Kang, Aoran Xiao, Jiahao Nie, Ling Shao, Shijian Lu
arxiv-2309-13505.description: Abstract Vision-Language Pre-training has demonstrated its remarkable zero-shot recognition ability and potential to learn generalizable visual representations from language supervision. Taking a step ahead, language-supervised semantic segmentation enables spatial localization of textual inputs by learning pixel grouping solely from image-text pairs.

arxiv-2409-16628.title: Lepton-flavor violation in the left-right supersymmetric standard model
arxiv-2409-16628.creator: Yong-Kang Huang 1 , Jin-Lei Yang 2,3 , Sheng-Kai Cui 1 , Tai-Fu Feng 1,2,3,4
arxiv-2409-16628.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yong-Kang Huang 1 , Jin-Lei Yang 2,3 , Sheng-Kai Cui 1 , Tai-Fu Feng 1,2,3,4. In the Standard Model (SM), the charged lepton-flavor violation (CLFV) processes are forbidden, so the observation of CLFV represents a clear signal of new physics that goes beyond the Standard Model.

arxiv-2411-10984.title: Rips and regular future scenario with Holographic Dark Energy : A comprehensive look
arxiv-2411-10984.creator: I. Brevik, Maxim Khlopov, S.D. Odintsov, Alexander V. Timoshkin, Oem Trivedi
arxiv-2411-10984.description: Abstract Interest on the possible future scenarios the universe could have has grew substantially with breakthroughs on late-time acceleration. Holographic dark energy (HDE) presents a very interesting approach towards addressing late-time acceleration, presenting an intriguing interface of ideas from quantum gravity and cosmology.

arxiv-2505-20523.title: Achievable Rates and Error Exponents for a Class of Mismatched Compound Channels
arxiv-2505-20523.creator: Priyanka Patel, Francesc Molina and Albert Guillén i Fàbregas
arxiv-2505-20523.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Priyanka Patel, Francesc Molina and Albert Guillén i Fàbregas. This paper investigates achievable information rates and error exponents of mismatched decoding when the channel belongs to the class of channels that are close to the decoding metric in terms of relative entropy.

arxiv-2507-10690.title: Natural super-orbitals representation of many-body operators
arxiv-2507-10690.creator: Maxime Debertolis
arxiv-2507-10690.description: Abstract We introduce the concept of natural super-orbitals for many-body operators, defined as the eigenvectors of the one-body super-density matrix associated with a vectorized operator. We first analyze the general analytical properties of these objects in various contexts, including the time-evolution operator of non-interacting Hamiltonians and Haar-random unitaries.

arxiv-2606-30742.title: ALMA visits the QSO MUSEUM: connecting molecular gas and the cool circumgalactic medium around 37 z ∼ 3 z\sim 3 quasars
arxiv-2606-30742.creator: Jelena Ritter, Fabrizio Arrigoni Battaia, Bo Peng, Jay González Lobos, Chian-Chou Chen, Aura Obreja, Nahir Muñoz-Elgueta, Chiara Circosta

pmc-10528865.title: Impact of Daily Choral Singing and Creative Writing Activities on the Cognitive Development of Second-, Third-, and Fourth-Grade French Children from Low Socioeconomic Backgrounds
pmc-10528865.creator: Angélica Gutiérrez Cisneros, Juliette Roussey, Talya Inbar, Althea Fratacci, Aline Frey, Javier Cachón-Zagalaz, Pedro Valdivia-Moral, María Sánchez Zafra, María del Carmen Campos-Mesa, Mª Luisa Zagalaz Sánchez
pmc-10528865.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). In France, around one-fifth of children have reading difficulties, and school results are highly dependent on their socio-economic status. In this context, the need for alternative and innovative teaching techniques holds importance, and more artistic approaches are promising. The aim of this study was to assess the impact of a daily choral singing or creative writing practice on the cognitive and linguistic development of French children from disadvantaged backgrounds.

pmc-10551784.title: Health Care and Social Work Students’ Experiences With a Virtual Reality Simulation Learning Activity: Qualitative Study
pmc-10551784.creator: Nikolina Helle, Miriam Dubland Vikman, Tone Dahl-Michelsen, Silje Stangeland Lie, Taiane de Azevedo Cardoso, Helen Berg, Samira Mehrabi
pmc-10551784.description: BackgroundVirtual reality is used to an increasing extent in various fields and is now making inroads into health and social education. Virtual reality simulation can provide a safe and controlled environment for students to practice and master skills that are transferable to real-world situations without putting patients, clients, or themselves at risk of any harm.

pmc-11355031.title: The Assessment of Upper Airway Volume Changes Following Bimaxillary Advancement Surgery: A Radiological Evaluation in the Supine Position at Multiple Intervals
pmc-11355031.creator: Paweł Piotr Grab, Michał Szałwiński, Maciej Jagielak, Jacek Rożko, Dariusz Jurkiewicz, Aldona Chloupek, Maria Sobol, Piotr Rot, Tobias Ettl
pmc-11355031.description: Background: Bimaxillary surgeries (BiMax) are an essential part of the craniomaxillofacial specialty. The osteotomies and subsequent spatial rearrangement of the maxilla and the mandible enable the correction of facial deformities, asymmetry, and malocclusion. Moreover, the movements performed during the procedure affect the morphology of surrounding soft tissues, including the upper airway (UA).

pmc-11431775.title: Identification of Key Proteins Related to Cashmere Fiber Diameter by Integrated Proteomics and Bioinformatic Analyses in the Alpas and Alxa Goat Breeds
pmc-11431775.creator: Chongyan Zhang, Qing Qin, Yichuan Wang, Zhixin Wang, Zhihong Liu, Chunjin Li, Shaobin Li
pmc-11431775.description: Background: Goats (Capra hircus) have always been a source of fiber for human use and hold an important place in international high-end textiles. Fiber diameter is the most concerning economic indicator for producers. Understanding the formation mechanism of fiber diameter and its related key proteins can help optimize and control the production of cashmere.

pmc-12437950.title: Transmagnetic Stimulation in Special Situations: Is Its Use Safe During Pregnancy?
pmc-12437950.creator: P Lusilla
pmc-12437950.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Abstract Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS) is a non-invasive procedure that uses magnetic fields to stimulate nerve cells in the brain. It is primarily used to treat depression and other mental health conditions. When it comes to the safety of TMS during pregnancy, the current evidence is limited but generally suggests that it may be a safer alternative to medications that could potentially harm the fetus.

pmc-12470546.title: Metabolic Dysregulation in Postmenopause: Implications for Knee Joint Health
pmc-12470546.creator: Ivana Minaković, Jelena Zvekić-Svorcan, Mirjana Smuđa, Bela Kolarš, Darko Mikić, Tanja Janković, Monika Šili, Miljanka Vuksanović, Nevena Đukić, Vesna Mijatović Jovin
pmc-12470546.description: Background/Objectives: Osteoarthritis is a slowly evolving joint disorder defined by cartilage degradation, synovial inflammation, subchondral bone hardening, and the growth of osteophytes. Increasing evidence highlights the role of metabolic factors in osteoarthritis onset and progression. This study investigated the link between metabolic syndrome and the level of knee impairment in postmenopausal respondents suffering from knee osteoarthritis.

pmc-13118605.title: First Molecularly Confirmed Outbreak of Bovine Pythiosis Caused by Pythium insidiosum in the Amazon Biome
pmc-13118605.creator: Janayna Barroso dos Santos, Hanna Gabriela da Silva Oliveira, André de Medeiros Costa Lins, Edson Moleta Colodel, Agnes de Souza Lima, Henrique dos Anjos Bomjardim, Flavio Roberto Chaves da Silva, Cíntia Daudt, Valeria Dutra, Felipe Masiero Salvarani
pmc-13118605.description: Pythiosis is a neglected infectious disease caused by the aquatic oomycete Pythium insidiosum and remains underrecognized in cattle, particularly in tropical regions. Here, we report the first molecularly confirmed outbreak of bovine pythiosis in the Amazon biome, affecting more than 400 animals raised under extensive production systems and areas with prolonged exposure to standing water.

pmc-13318863.title: PDGF-BB as a potential biomarker for early diagnosis of postpartum hemorrhage
pmc-13318863.creator: Karthikeyan Thirugnanam, Brock E. Polnaszek, Kevin Eng, Amy Y. Pan, Ramani Ramchandran

pmc-13519004.title: Research on deformation and seepage properties of Larssen pile reinforcing cofferdam based on numerical analysis, Tianjin, China
pmc-13519004.creator: Shejie Lin, Xinjian Wang, Xingsheng Zhang, Shipeng Liu
pmc-13519004.description: The construction of cofferdams poses significant challenges in hydraulic engineering, where optimized design is essential for risk mitigation and construction safety. This study investigates the performance of a Larssen pile-reinforced cofferdam in a field ridge remediation project through integrated numerical modeling and limit equilibrium analysis.

pmc-13546017.title: Journal Clubs in Medical Education: Contemporary Formats, Implementation Strategies, and Future Directions
pmc-13546017.creator: Patrick Juliebø-Jones
pmc-13546017.description: PurposeJournal clubs (JCs) remain an important component of medical education, providing opportunities for critical appraisal, evidence-based learning, and collaborative discussion. While traditional face-to-face meetings remain common, contemporary JCs have evolved to include online, hybrid, social media-based, and emerging AI-assisted models.
